intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded fees, placements and ranks from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.

Jain University vs Kristu Jayanti College is a fee-and-recency choice. Jain lists several specialised BCA streams at a higher recorded year fee. Kristu Jayanti has a lower recorded tuition and a more recent 2023 placement row.

sections.heading: Jain University vs Kristu Jayanti College for BCA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Jain University if you want a specialised BCA, such as data analytics, cybersecurity, AI and machine learning or cloud technology, and can budget for the recorded year total of ₹1.65 lakh.
Choose Kristu Jayanti College if you want a general BCA at the recorded tuition of ₹45,000 a year, with a 2023 record of ₹3 lakh average and ₹5 lakh highest.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Jain University we hold ₹1.65 lakh as a Total Fees year figure on several specialised BCA streams, and ₹1.30 lakh as tuition on a BCA Elective row. These are year amounts, not a confirmed three-year official total.
For Kristu Jayanti College we hold ₹45,000 as BCA tuition for one year. That is also a year figure, not a confirmed three-year official total, and we have not multiplied it.
The fee gap is large. Confirm the current notices on jainuniversity.ac.in and kristujayanti.edu.in before you decide.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Kristu Jayanti College has a 2023 BCA row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹5 lakh highest. That is a historical record, not a promise.

Jain University's only BCA placement row here is from 2019, with ₹4 lakh average and ₹5 lakh highest for the data-analytics stream. Because it is before 2020, our summary table does not treat it as a current flagship figure.
If you need a like-for-like 2024 or 2025 comparison, ask both placement cells for the latest official report.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each college's official undergraduate admissions process for 2026.
On our records, Kristu Jayanti has India Today ranks of 4 in 2024 and 2023. Jain University has India Today ranks of 13 in 2024 and 14 in 2023. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Bangalore, Karnataka, so the city is the same. The daily commute still depends on the exact campus.
Jain lists many specialised BCA titles on this page. Kristu Jayanti lists a single BCA programme. Match the specialisation you actually want, not only the fee.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Jain University if a named BCA specialisation is the priority and the recorded ₹1.65 lakh year fee is acceptable, after you get a placement report newer than 2019.
Pick Kristu Jayanti College if the recorded ₹45,000 year tuition, the 2023 placement row, and the India Today ranks of 4 fit your plan.
Do not stretch Jain's 2019 row into a current package comparison.
